description.usage: Explore congressional members and recurring hearing witnesses grouped across appearances. Non-member witnesses group only when normalized names and full normalized organizations agree under middle-initial and suffix guards.

schema.name: people
schema.dataGranularityDescription: One Member of Congress (by Bioguide) or one non-Member witness group sharing normalized name and full normalized organization under middle-initial and suffix guards (or one singleton appearance)
schema.description: Explore congressional members and recurring hearing witnesses grouped across appearances. Non-member witnesses group only when normalized names and full normalized organizations agree under middle-initial and suffix guards.

properties.name: person_key

customProperties.value: Archive person_key (Bioguide ID for matched Members, 16-hex hash otherwise).

properties.description: Published person identifier: Bioguide ID for Members; lowercase 16-hex SHA-256 prefix over ["person-v1", name_key, org_key, middle, suffix] for grouped non-Members or ["person-singleton-v1", witness_key] when organization is empty or name is unusable

properties.name: bioguide_id
properties.description: Bioguide identifier in members.parquet when grouping_basis is bioguide; null otherwise

properties.name: name
properties.description: Primary display name from the person's most recent canonical appearance

properties.name: rank
properties.description: Primary military or uniformed-service rank from the person's most recent canonical appearance stating one; null when none is stated

properties.name: ranks

items.description: Stated military or uniformed-service rank strings from hearing records; values, not keys.

properties.description: Distinct non-empty stated military or uniformed-service ranks across the person's canonical appearances, sorted

properties.name: credentials
properties.description: Primary post-nominal credentials from the person's most recent canonical appearance stating any; null when none are stated

properties.name: name_variants

items.description: Stated display strings from hearing records; values, not keys.

properties.description: Distinct stated names across the person's canonical appearances, sorted

properties.name: organization
properties.description: Primary stated organization from the person's most recent canonical appearance naming one; null when none is stated

properties.name: organizations

items.description: Stated organization strings from hearing records; values, not keys.

properties.description: Distinct non-empty stated organizations across the person's canonical appearances, sorted

properties.name: positions

items.description: Stated position/title strings from hearing records; values, not keys.

properties.description: Distinct non-empty stated titles/positions across the person's canonical appearances, sorted

properties.name: grouping_basis
properties.description: How the person's appearances were grouped: bioguide, name_organization, singleton, or reviewed

properties.name: appearance_count
properties.description: Count of canonical (superseded_by IS NULL) appearances belonging to this person

properties.name: hearing_count
properties.description: Count of distinct hearing occasions across canonical appearances belonging to this person

properties.name: first_seen_date
properties.description: Earliest hearing date across canonical appearances; null when every appearance is undated

properties.name: last_seen_date
properties.description: Latest hearing date across canonical appearances; null when every appearance is undated

properties.name: witness_keys

items.description: Canonical witness_key references into witnesses.parquet; superseded witness rows also carry person_key on witnesses.parquet.

properties.description: Sorted canonical witness_key values belonging to this person

customProperties.value: person_key, name, grouping_basis, counts, and list columns are required; bioguide_id, rank, credentials, organization, and date bounds are nullable.

value: Non-Members merge only on exact normalized name plus full normalized organization with middle-initial and suffix guards; career moves across employers, sub-unit vs parent agency variants, and appearances with empty organizations remain separate person rows until reviewed cross-employer evidence ships

value.meaning: Member of Congress record when a person row is grouped by Bioguide ID.
Canonical (superseded_by IS NULL) witness appearance rows belonging to this person.
